meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描蛋白质序列,标出 N-糖基化位点和 O-糖基化热点,并借助糖工程工具给出分析与改造建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析蛋白质糖基化、优化治疗性抗体或设计疫苗抗原时触发。

say.text: 请扫描这条蛋白质序列中的 N-糖基化位点。
say.note: Claude 会返回位点、基序和上下文。

say.text: 把 Fc 第 297 位天冬酰胺突变成谷氨酰胺。
say.note: 这能去除 Fc 糖基化。

say.text: 预测这条序列的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: Claude 会运行启发式预测器。

howto.what_en: Claude can scan protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons, predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and provide glycosylation analysis and engineering guidance using tools like NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, and GlycoWorkbench.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze protein glycosylation, optimize a therapeutic antibody, or design a vaccine antigen.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Claude returns positions, motifs, and context.

say_en.text: Mutate asparagine 297 in the Fc to glutamine.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots for this sequence.
